name: nonpagedldapsearch
help: Execute non-paged LDAP searches against Active Directory
long_help: Performs LDAP queries against Active Directory without paging support. Use this when the target LDAP server does not support paged results. Results may be limited by server-side size restrictions (typically 1000 entries). For most use cases, prefer sa-ldapsearch which handles paging automatically.

arguments.name: attributes
arguments.desc: Comma-separated list of attributes to return (e.g., 'sAMAccountName,mail,memberOf'). Omit to return all attributes.

arguments.name: result_limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results to display. 0 or omit for no limit. Note: server may still truncate at its own limit (e.g., 1000).

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target Domain Controller hostname or IP. Default: auto-discovered via DsGetDcName.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Distinguished Name for search base (e.g., 'DC=corp,DC=local'). Default: current domain DN.
